Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

chromy 0.2.0

  • Exact second-order inclusion probabilities: joint_inclusion() evaluates the closed forms of Chauvet and Le Gleut (2021) for the without-replacement design under the random head, and as_svydesign(variance = "pps") hands them to survey::ppsmat(), making the Sen–Yates–Grundy variance exact.
  • Successive difference replication: as_svrepdesign() builds the Fay–Train replicate-weights design (the American Community Survey convention), certainty rows unperturbed.
  • The selector alone: pmr() for pipelines in the sampling package’s idiom; as_svydesign() and weights() bridge to survey.
  • Engine chromy-core 0.2.0, with minimum replacement verified as a runtime invariant on every selection.

chromy 0.1.0

  • First release: chromy_sample(), serpentine_order(), mpps_size(), eqcv_allocation(), expected_hits() and estimate_total(), on the engine chromy-core 0.1.0.
